title: Halcom is narrow: 163 people around its own payments and e-signature products
content:
Halcom is recorded as narrow at 163 staff, with its own payments and e-signature products as the only stack on file. Both facts point the same way: a small firm organised around a specific product line.

Owning products is the pattern that repeatedly counts against leads in this set, because a firm's own application occupies the layer a partnership would need. Combined with a narrow footprint and a small bench, there is little in the record to build a case on. Priority 4, needs OSS screen.
